decisions.question: S80 applied S79's amend of bus-api@v2 (the bus is running from the moment start() begins; a nested start() does nothing; removeTopic from the work start() runs throws StateError) as compatible within v2, marking it would_have_asked and breaking-amend because one point touches 'which operation throws what'. Does the orchestrator, deciding stops under DEC-686, accept it?

options.label: Accept within v2
options.consequence: G34, G9 and G42 say what a call made during start() does; two existing cases are extended; bus-api stays v2 draft.

options.label: Revert and leave calls during start() unstated
options.consequence: The runtime plan (D8) still has to pick a behavior, and consumers that react to a step-3 deep link (navigation and flutter executors) would have no guarantee for activating a PAGE topology from that callback.

decisions.why: bus-api@v2 is a draft authored in this intake, so the Breaking list protects no consumer yet; the replay on a runtime seeded to the other reading passes every consumer suite, so nothing relies on either reading; and leaving it unstated would push the choice into the runtime's code. The Spec gap is recorded for upstreaming.
